root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from insufficient validation of the `i2c_smbus_read_block_data` return value in `tps53679_identify_chip`, which allows a zero-length read to bypass error handling and trigger an out-of-bounds stack access via a negative array index.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (ret < 0)` to `if (ret <= 0)` in `drivers/hwmon/pmbus/tps53679.c`, addressing the CVE description which states that a return value of 0 causes `buf[ret - 1]` to become `buf[-1]`.
